captures.label: latency-long-base
captures.prompt: Explain why compiled model artifacts reduce cold-start latency in GPU serving. Cover TTFT, weight loading, tokenizer startup, CUDA context creation, graph warmup, memory mapping, scheduler readiness, and why avoiding repeated runtime initialization improves startup consistency during autoscaling.

captures.label: batching-long-base
captures.prompt: Summarize the main serving benefits of continuous batching for LLM inference. Cover GPU utilization, throughput, queue efficiency, request interleaving, tail latency, mixed prompt lengths, and why admitting work continuously is better than draining static batches.

captures.label: kv-long-base
captures.prompt: Explain how paged KV cache reduces memory fragmentation during LLM serving. Cover fixed-size blocks, allocation churn, memory reuse, long-context stability, allocator pressure, and how block-based reuse interacts with continuous batching.
